name: Chat thread
summary: A one-to-one message thread with the other person's photo: bubbles on both sides grouped into runs, a quoted reply, a heart reaction, a read receipt, a typing indicator and a composer with attach and send that adds your message.
use: in a messaging or social app, for a private conversation
a11y: The thread is a log region that can be scrolled with the keyboard, the typing indicator is a status, the quoted reply and reaction have screen-reader text, and Send stays disabled until there is text.

use_when: a buyer and seller talking about one listing, where replies and reactions help keep track
avoid_when: a list of many conversations: use notification-inbox or member-list
a customer talking to a support agent: use live-chat
talking with an AI assistant: use chat-answer or ai-composer

parts.name: back
parts.what: goes back to the list of conversations

parts.name: avatar
parts.what: the other person's photo, with a green dot when they are online

parts.name: presence
parts.what: whether they are active, or when they last were

parts.name: calls
parts.what: voice and video call buttons; video hides in a very narrow box

parts.name: day
parts.what: the day and time the conversation starts

parts.name: messages
parts.what: one message bubble: theirs on the left, yours on the right, grouped into runs

parts.name: quote
parts.what: the message being replied to, inside a bubble

parts.name: reaction
parts.what: a heart reaction pinned to a bubble

parts.name: seen
parts.what: the read receipt under your newest message

parts.name: typing
parts.what: three moving dots while they type

parts.name: send
parts.what: sends the message; disabled while the field is empty

empty.how: with no messages yet, show the other person's photo and name centred in the log with a line like 'Say hello'

loading.how: keep the header and composer and fill the log with three grey bubbles on alternating sides

error.how: if a message fails to send, change its receipt from 'Sent' to 'Not sent' with a retry button, or show toast-stack

disabled.how: Send is greyed out and disabled until the field has text, and again after sending

overflow.how: the log scrolls in its own box inside a capped card height and starts at the newest message

long_text.how: bubbles wrap and break long words; the person's name in the header is cut off with an ellipsis

keyboard: Tab moves through Back, Voice call and Video call, then the conversation, which the arrow keys scroll, then Attach, the message field and Send
Enter in the message field sends it when it has text; the field keeps focus for the next message
Enter or Space presses the focused button
